The closed-loop natural frequency is sqrt(gm1/(Cin*Rf*Co)), so the gain node is kept at under 10 fF and A sets Q to about 0.7-1. Current budget: iref 10 + 1 (PMOS bias) + 11 (gain stage) + 7 (follower) = 29 uA, about 52 uW. Vin is about Vgs1 (0.45 V); vout is about 0.45 + |Vgs,p| ≈ 1.3 V."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 10.0, 22.0),
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "I1":    (11e-6, 5e-6, 18e-6),
    "If":    (7e-6, 3e-6, 12e-6),
    "gmidp": (10.0, 6.0, 15.0),
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),
    "gmid3": (13.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "L3":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "Rf":    (440e3, 380e3, 650e3),
    "Ip0":   (1e-6, 0.5e-6, 3e-6),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    kT4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    Rf = p["Rf"]
    I1, If, Ip0 = p["I1"], p["If"], p["Ip0"]

    # Gain stage: NMOS CS. Rf sets vin = vo at DC (approx. Vgs1)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.45)
    vin_dc = m1.vgs
    # PMOS bias diode and mirror loads (same gm/Id and L)
    mp0 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ip0, vds=0.9)
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=VDD - vin_dc)
    # PMOS source follower (bulk = source, so no body effect)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], If, vds=vin_dc + 0.85)
    vout_dc = vin_dc + m3.vgs
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], If, vds=max(VDD - vout_dc, 0.2))
    # NMOS reference diode (IREF) and mirror sinking Ip0 from the PMOS diode
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 12.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 12.0, 1.0, Ip0, vds=VDD - mp0.vgs)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MB1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp0)
    n.dev("M1", "ao", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "ao", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.R("RF", "ao", "iin", Rf)
    n.dev("M3", "vss", "ao", "vout", "vout", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m4)

    # ---- small-signal prediction ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    go = m1.gds + m2.gds
    gfo = m3.gm + m3.gds + m4.gds
    af = m3.gm / gfo
    Cgd = m1.cgd
    Ci = cpd + max(m1.cgg - m1.cgd, 0.0)
    Co = m1.cdd + m2.cdd + m3.cgd + (1 - af) * max(m3.cgg - m3.cgd, 0.0)
    Cout = cl + m3.cdd + m4.cdd

    def zt(f):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cgd
        # [ s*Ci+yf , -yf ; gm1-yf , go+s*Co+yf ] [vi;vo] = [I;0]
        a11, a12 = s * Ci + yf, -yf
        a21, a22 = gm1 - yf, go + s * Co + yf
        det = a11 * a22 - a12 * a21
        vo = -a21 / det
        return vo * af / (1 + s * Cout / gfo)

    z0 = abs(zt(1e3))
    freqs = np.logspace(5, 10, 2000)
    zs = np.abs(np.array([zt(f) for f in freqs]))
    below = np.where(zs < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3 = float(freqs[below[0]]) if len(below) else 1e10

    # Noise at 1 MHz: Rf thermal plus amplifier voltage noise times input admittance
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    en2 = kT4 * (gm1 + m2.gm) / gm1 ** 2
    yin2 = (1.0 / Rf) ** 2 + (w * (Ci + Cgd)) ** 2
    in_noise = math.sqrt(kT4 / Rf + en2 * yin2)

    power = VDD * (iref + Ip0 + I1 + If)
    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(z0),
        "f3db": f3,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout_dc,
        "in_noise_1m": in_noise,
    }
```

The power budget assumes the testbench reference current is 10 µA (`spec.get("iref", 10e-6)`), because its value isn't given. If the real IREF is larger, every mirrored current scales up with it and the 54 µW limit is at risk.
